f3_program: collection("helga.shoe_pairs_tried_by_store", "store_trial_count", "helga.shopping_trip", source("At the first store, she tried on 7 pairs of shoes"))
member("helga.shoe_pairs_tried_by_store", "helga.shoe_pairs_tried.first_store.count", source("At the first store, she tried on 7 pairs of shoes"))
member("helga.shoe_pairs_tried_by_store", "helga.shoe_pairs_tried.second_store.count", source("At the second store, she tried on 2 more pairs than at the first store"))
member("helga.shoe_pairs_tried_by_store", "helga.shoe_pairs_tried.third_store.count", source("At the third store, she did not try on any shoes"))

member("helga.shoe_pairs_tried_by_store", "helga.shoe_pairs_tried.fourth_store.count", source("at the fourth store, she tried on twice as many pairs of shoes as she did at all three other stores combined"))
observe(at("helga.shoe_pairs_tried.first_store.count", "before_purchase"), 7, "count", source("At the first store, she tried on 7 pairs of shoes"))

offset(at("helga.shoe_pairs_tried.second_store.count", "before_purchase"), at("helga.shoe_pairs_tried.first_store.count", "before_purchase"), 2, "count", source("At the second store, she tried on 2 more pairs than at the first store"))
observe(at("helga.shoe_pairs_tried.third_store.count", "before_purchase"), 0, "count", source("At the third store, she did not try on any shoes"))

sum_relation(at("helga.shoe_pairs_tried.first_three_stores.count", "before_purchase"), at("helga.shoe_pairs_tried.first_store.count", "before_purchase"), at("helga.shoe_pairs_tried.second_store.count", "before_purchase"), at("helga.shoe_pairs_tried.third_store.count", "before_purchase"), source("all three other stores combined"))

multiple(at("helga.shoe_pairs_tried.fourth_store.count", "before_purchase"), at("helga.shoe_pairs_tried.first_three_stores.count", "before_purchase"), 2, source("twice as many pairs of shoes as she did at all three other stores combined"))
query("sum", "helga.shoe_pairs_tried_by_store", "before_purchase")

f3_program: collection("angeli.candies", "candy", "angeli", source("Angeli had 90 assorted candies"))
observe(at("angeli.candies.count", "initial"), 90, "count", source("Angeli had 90 assorted candies"))
fraction_of(at("angeli.candies.lollipops.count", "initial"), at("angeli.candies.count", "initial"), 1, 3, source("One-third of the candies were lollipops"))

sum_relation(at("angeli.candies.count", "initial"), at("angeli.candies.lollipops.count", "initial"), at("angeli.candies.candy_canes.count", "initial"), source("One-third of the candies were lollipops and the rest were candy canes"))

transfer("share_lollipops", "angeli", at("angeli.candies.lollipops.count", "current"), at("angeli.recipients.boys.lollipops_received.count", "current"), at("angeli.candies.lollipops.count", "initial"), source("She then shared the lollipops equally among the boys such that each boy received 3"))
observe(at("angeli.recipients.boys.each.lollipops_received.count", "current"), 3, "count", source("each boy received 3"))

product_relation(event_field("share_lollipops", "quantity"), at("angeli.recipients.boys.count", "current"), at("angeli.recipients.boys.each.lollipops_received.count", "current"), source("shared the lollipops equally among the boys such that each boy received 3"))

transfer("share_candy_canes", "angeli", at("angeli.candies.candy_canes.count", "current"), at("angeli.recipients.girls.candy_canes_received.count", "current"), at("angeli.candies.candy_canes.count", "initial"), source("She then shared the candy canes equally among the girls such that each received 2"))
observe(at("angeli.recipients.girls.each.candy_canes_received.count", "current"), 2, "count", source("among the girls such that each received 2"))

product_relation(event_field("share_candy_canes", "quantity"), at("angeli.recipients.girls.count", "current"), at("angeli.recipients.girls.each.candy_canes_received.count", "current"), source("shared the candy canes equally among the girls such that each received 2"))

collection("angeli.recipients.group_counts", "recipient_group_count", "angeli.candy_sharing", source("She then shared the lollipops equally among the boys such that each boy received 3. She then shared the candy canes equally among the girls such that each received 2"))
member("angeli.recipients.group_counts", "angeli.recipients.boys.count", source("among the boys such that each boy received 3"))
member("angeli.recipients.group_counts", "angeli.recipients.girls.count", source("among the girls such that each received 2"))
query("sum", "angeli.recipients.group_counts", "current")

observe(at("alex.trip.downhill_segment.speed", "downhill_segment"), 24, "mile_per_hour", source("mostly coast at 24 miles per hour"))

rate_relation("alex.trip.downhill_segment.distance", at("alex.trip.downhill_segment.speed", "downhill_segment"), at("alex.trip.downhill_segment.duration", "downhill_segment"), source("the road declined downhill and was able to mostly coast at 24 miles per hour. Unfortunately, he only got to enjoy this for one and a half hours before he punctured a tire"))

remove("ride_downhill_segment", "alex", at("alex.trip.distance_remaining_to_next_town", "current"), "alex.trip.downhill_segment.distance", source("the road declined downhill and was able to mostly coast at 24 miles per hour. Unfortunately, he only got to enjoy this for one and a half hours before he punctured a tire"))

remove("walk_to_next_town", "alex", at("alex.trip.distance_remaining_to_next_town", "current"), at("alex.trip.distance_remaining_to_next_town", "current"), source("he had to walk his bike the rest of the way to the next town"))
query("value", event_field("walk_to_next_town", "quantity"))
collection("dean.pizzas", "pizza", "dean", source("Dean ordered 2 large pizzas"))
observe(at("dean.pizzas.count", "initial"), 2, "count", source("Dean ordered 2 large pizzas"))
collection("dean.pizzas.slices", "slice", "dean.pizzas", source("2 large pizzas that were each cut into 12 slices"))
observe(at("dean.pizzas.slices.hawaiian.count", "initial"), 12, "count", source("2 large pizzas that were each cut into 12 slices"))
observe(at("dean.pizzas.slices.cheese.count", "initial"), 12, "count", source("2 large pizzas that were each cut into 12 slices"))

consume("dean_eats_hawaiian", "dean", at("dean.pizzas.slices.hawaiian.count", "current"), fraction(at("dean.pizzas.slices.hawaiian.count", "initial"), 1, 2), source("Dean was hungry and ate half of the Hawaiian pizza"))
consume("frank_eats_hawaiian", "frank", at("dean.pizzas.slices.hawaiian.count", "current"), 3, source("Frank only ate 3 slices of Hawaiian pizza"))

consume("sammy_eats_cheese", "sammy", at("dean.pizzas.slices.cheese.count", "current"), fraction(at("dean.pizzas.slices.cheese.count", "initial"), 1, 3), source("Sammy ate a third of the cheese pizza"))
query("remaining_count", "dean.pizzas.slices", "current")
